outputs.explanation: Panel A consists only of micrographs (fluorescence images), not a plot of averaged data.
The two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) show group means with error bars (n=20) but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot, not a plot of averaged data.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts display group means with error bars (N indicated in bars) but do not show the individual data points underlying each mean.

The FACS panels are frequency histograms (cell count vs. TMRM intensity) showing the full distribution of individual cells, a plot type exempt from requiring separately overlaid individual data points.
